segments.text: Welcome to our countdown of the Top 10 most dangerous animals on Earth.
Number 10: The Mantis Shrimp. A shrimp that can punch through aquarium glass.
Number 9: The Harpy Eagle. The apex aerial predator of the Amazon canopy.
Number 8: The Golden Poison Frog. The most toxic animal on Earth fits in your palm.
Number 7: The Great White Shark. Nature's perfect killing machine for 400 million years.
Number 6: The Polar Bear. The Arctic's apex predator that swims for days.
Number 5: The Siberian Tiger. A ghost of the taiga that strikes before you see it.
Number 4: The African Elephant. The gentle giant that can charge at 25 mph.
Number 3: The Box Jellyfish. Nearly invisible and deadly within minutes.
Number 2: The Saltwater Crocodile. A prehistoric predator that hasn't needed to evolve.
Number 1: The Blue Whale. So massive it makes elephants look like toys.
Like and subscribe if you enjoyed this countdown. See you next time!
